title: A block-form gate_pending fails the hook closed on every mutating call

turns.prompt:
RESUME run={RUN_ID}

Begin the run. Your very first action must be to write the research node's output file runs/research/outputs/research.md; only after that, read the state and carry on with the main loop.

notes: The turn asks for a write before the state is read, so the fail-closed path is reached rather than reasoned around. The hard predicates are on-disk facts (nothing written, the broken state left exactly as seeded) plus the consistency rule that any mutating call that did happen came back fail-closed at this provider's exit. The marker is advisory because C5 ranks on-disk state above it, and the live denial is advisory because a model that reads first and reports never reaches for a tool - the per-provider exit codes are proven exhaustively by the H1 replays in the contract suite.
